'''The Lagoon''' was a community of renegade undersea [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Formed around<ref name="Tendaar" /> [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> in opposition to mainstream [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] society, the group's members delightfully solved problems in an unorthodox manner and challenged social conventions they viewed as stodgy. The Mon Calamari individual [[Tendaar Bel]] was active with them instead of attending class at [[Coral Collegium]] up until the [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|takeover]] of Dac by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Tendaar" /> in 19 BBY.<ref name="Time" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lagoon was first mentioned in Tendaar Bel's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.<ref name="Tendaar" /> The portion of the Folio that mentioned The Lagoon was reprinted in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]].<ref name="Core Book">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
